description: Java and Fabric Minecraft client-side development project exploring performance, customization, and clean code.

releases.notes:
Experimental ClientPulse test build for Minecraft 1.8.9.

- Target: Minecraft 1.8.9 with Forge 11.15.1.2318
- Java: 8
- Install `clientpulse-1.8.9-0.1.0.jar` into the `mods` folder of a matching Forge profile.
- Open the Click GUI with Right Shift. Use the new **COSMETICS** header button to open Cosmetics Studio; press Escape there to return. The existing `C` shortcut remains available while the Click GUI is open.
- Cosmetics render for the local player only and are not synchronized to other clients.
- Source for this refreshed binary: [commit c5211ad](https://github.com/ruhioki/ClientPulse/commit/c5211ad1776afcaeb2646124e04e53327eb369c8) on `feature/clientpulse-phase-one-gui`.
- Verification: clean 1.8.9 Forge test/build passed (14 tests). The new button is build-verified; direct mouse navigation and OptiFine compatibility have not been separately runtime-tested.
- SHA-256: `F629458FCEA878177EDCF199B625D388AB3FD4766677A92962DAB5CC4FF51E03`

This is a prerelease for compatibility testing, not a stable release. Use a separate game profile and share the full log if the combined setup fails.
